top_signals.title: No bailout for Jaguar Land Rover amid job cuts, says business secretary
top_signals.summary: Business secretary Jonathan Reynolds has said the government will not bail out Jaguar Land Rover after it announced plans to slash 4,000 jobs. Reynolds has spoken to PB Balaji, chief executive of Britain’s biggest carmaker, and is due to meet with the company’s leadership in the coming days.  But he told the BBC’s Laura Kuenssberg [...]

top_signals.title: Commission greenlights the Netherlands' fourth payment request for €661 million under NextGenerationEU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 07 Sep 2026 Today, the European Commission positively assessed the Netherlands' fourth payment request of €661 million in grants under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.
